examples.target: 這次實習是一個學習新技能的黃金機會。

examples.source: If you want to study abroad, this is a golden opportunity.
examples.target: 如果你想出國留學，這是一個難得的機會。

examples.source: She grabbed the golden opportunity when the manager offered her a job.
examples.target: 當經理向她提供工作時，她把握住了這個黃金機會。

examples.source: The golden retriever is a very friendly and popular family dog.
examples.target: 金毛尋回犬是一種非常友善且受歡迎的家庭犬。

examples.source: My golden retriever loves to play fetch in the park.
examples.target: 我的金毛尋回犬很喜歡在公園玩拋接球遊戲。

examples.source: If you have a golden retriever, you must brush its fur often.
examples.target: 如果你養了一隻金毛尋回犬，就必須經常幫牠梳理毛髮。

examples.source: Bake the cookies until they turn a perfect golden-brown.
examples.target: 把曲奇焗到變成完美的金黃色。

examples.source: The toast is golden-brown and smells very delicious.
examples.target: 這片多士呈金黃色，聞起來非常香。

examples.source: Fry the chicken until the skin is crispy and golden-brown.
examples.target: 把雞肉炸到雞皮變得香脆金黃。

examples.source: The professional golfer practiced his swing at the club all morning.
examples.target: 那位職業高爾夫球手整個早上都在俱樂部練習揮桿。

examples.source: My father is a keen golfer who plays every Sunday morning.
examples.target: 我爸爸是一位熱衷的高爾夫球手，他每個星期日早上都會去打球。

examples.source: If you want to be a good golfer, you must practice daily.
examples.target: 如果你想成為一名優秀的高爾夫球手，就必須每天練習。

examples.source: I am gonna finish my homework before I go out.
examples.target: 我打算做完功課先出去。

examples.source: It is gonna rain soon, so take your umbrella.
examples.target: 快要下雨了，記得帶雨傘。

examples.source: We are gonna have a party when the exam ends.
examples.target: 考試結束後，我們打算開個派對。

examples.source: She is a good fit for the school basketball team.
examples.target: 她很適合加入校隊。

examples.source: This job is a good fit because I like helping people.
examples.target: 這份工作很適合我，因為我喜歡幫助別人。

examples.source: I think this new student is a good fit for our class.
examples.target: 我覺得這位新同學很適合我們班。

examples.source: Buying a good laptop is a good investment for your studies.
examples.target: 買一部好的手提電腦對你的學業來說是一項值得的投資。

examples.source: Learning a new language is always a good investment of time.
examples.target: 學習一門新語言總是一項值得的時間投資。

examples.source: If you want to stay healthy, exercise is a good investment.
examples.target: 如果你想保持健康，運動是一項值得的投資。

examples.source: You showed good judgment when you decided to study for the test.
examples.target: 你決定溫習考試，顯示你有良好的判斷力。

examples.source: It takes good judgment to know when to ask for help.
examples.target: 懂得何時尋求協助，需要良好的判斷力。

examples.source: She has good judgment because she always thinks before she speaks.
examples.target: 她有良好的判斷力，因為她說話前總是會先思考。

examples.source: Our new teacher is very good with kids.
examples.target: 我們的新老師非常擅長與小朋友相處。

examples.source: He is good with kids because he is very patient.
examples.target: 他很擅長與小朋友相處，因為他非常有耐性。

examples.source: If you are good with kids, you can be a volunteer.
examples.target: 如果你擅長與小朋友相處，你可以去當義工。

examples.source: The teacher gave us some goodies after the class ended.
examples.target: 課堂結束後，老師給了我們一些小禮物。

examples.source: There are many healthy goodies in this snack box.
examples.target: 這個零食盒裡裝滿了許多健康的好東西。

examples.source: If you finish your homework, you can have some goodies.
examples.target: 如果你完成功課，就可以得到一些小禮物。

examples.source: Batman protects the people living in Gotham City every night.
examples.target: 蝙蝠俠每晚都保護著住在葛咸城的市民。

examples.source: Many famous comic book stories take place in Gotham City.
examples.target: 許多著名的漫畫故事都是以葛咸城為背景。

examples.source: I like watching movies about the heroes of Gotham City.
examples.target: 我喜歡看關於葛咸城英雄的電影。

examples.source: I gotta go now because my bus is arriving soon.
examples.target: 我現在要走了，因為巴士很快就到。

examples.source: You gotta finish your homework if you want to play games.
examples.target: 如果你想玩電子遊戲，就一定要做完功課。

examples.source: We gotta hurry or we will be late for school.
examples.target: 我們要快一點，否則上學會遲到。

examples.source: I have gotten a new laptop for my school project.
examples.target: 我為學校專題研習買了一部新手提電腦。

examples.source: She has gotten much better at playing the piano lately.
examples.target: 她最近彈鋼琴的技術進步了很多。

examples.source: We have gotten lost because we did not check the map.
examples.target: 因為我們沒有看地圖，所以迷路了。

examples.source: You should contact a government agency if you need help.
examples.target: 如果你需要幫助，應該聯絡政府機構。

examples.source: My father works for a government agency in the city.
examples.target: 我爸爸在市內的一間政府機構工作。

examples.source: The government agency will provide information about the new park.
examples.target: 政府機構會提供關於新公園的資訊。

examples.source: Many people go to vote during the government election.
examples.target: 很多人會在政府選舉期間去投票。

examples.source: We learned about the government election in our social studies class.
examples.target: 我們在社會科課堂上學習了關於政府選舉的知識。

examples.source: The city will hold a government election next month.
examples.target: 這個城市將於下個月舉行政府選舉。

government fund.meaning: 政府撥款 / 政府基金

examples.source: The school applied for a government fund to build a new library.
examples.target: 學校申請了政府撥款來興建新圖書館。

examples.source: We can start the science project if we get the government fund.
examples.target: 如果我們得到政府撥款，就可以開始科學項目。

examples.source: The government fund helps local artists share their work with the public.
examples.target: 這項政府基金幫助本地藝術家與公眾分享他們的作品。

examples.source: The government spokesperson explained the new policy to the reporters.
examples.target: 政府發言人向記者解釋了這項新政策。

examples.source: When the meeting started, the government spokesperson answered many questions.
examples.target: 會議開始時，政府發言人回答了許多問題。

examples.source: The government spokesperson said that the park will open tomorrow.
examples.target: 政府發言人表示公園將於明天開放。

examples.source: Local businesses need government support to survive during the hard times.
examples.target: 本地企業在困難時期需要政府支援才能生存。

examples.source: The startup grew quickly because it received strong government support.
examples.target: 這間初創公司發展迅速，因為它得到了強大的政府支援。

examples.source: If the project gets government support, we can finish it soon.
examples.target: 如果這個項目得到政府支援，我們很快就能完成。

examples.source: My brother joined a government-funded scheme to learn coding skills.
examples.target: 我哥哥參加了一個政府資助計劃來學習編程技巧。

examples.source: The government-funded scheme helps students pay for their school trips.
examples.target: 這個政府資助計劃幫助學生支付學校旅行的費用。

examples.source: We applied for the government-funded scheme because we needed support.
examples.target: 我們申請了那個政府資助計劃，因為我們需要支援。

examples.source: Let's grab a bite before we start our homework.
examples.target: 不如我們做功課前先簡單吃點東西。

examples.source: We can grab a bite if you are hungry now.
examples.target: 如果你現在肚餓，我們可以簡單吃點東西。

examples.source: I usually grab a bite when I finish school early.
examples.target: 我通常在提早放學時會簡單吃點東西。

examples.source: The bright poster helps to grab attention of the students.
examples.target: 這張色彩鮮豔的海報有助於吸引學生的注意。

examples.source: He waved his hand to grab attention when the teacher spoke.
examples.target: 當老師說話時，他揮手以吸引注意。

examples.source: The shop owner uses loud music to grab attention of customers.
examples.target: 店主用大聲的音樂來吸引顧客的注意。

examples.source: Please grab on to the handrail when the bus moves.
examples.target: 當巴士行駛時，請緊緊抓住扶手。

examples.source: You should grab on to the rope if you feel dizzy.
examples.target: 如果你覺得頭暈，就應該抓住那條繩子。

examples.source: The child had to grab on to his mother's hand tightly.
examples.target: 那個小孩必須緊緊地捉住他媽媽的手。

examples.source: My sister is a graduate student at the university now.
examples.target: 我姐姐現在是一位大學研究生。

examples.source: The graduate student works in the lab every single day.
examples.target: 那位研究生每天都在實驗室工作。

examples.source: If you become a graduate student, you will study more.
examples.target: 如果你成為研究生，你需要學習更多知識。

examples.source: The graffiti artist painted a colorful mural on the wall.
examples.target: 那位塗鴉藝術家在牆上畫了一幅色彩繽紛的壁畫。

examples.source: My brother wants to be a graffiti artist when he grows up.
examples.target: 我弟弟長大後想成為一名塗鴉藝術家。

examples.source: The graffiti artist used many bright colors for his new work.
examples.target: 那位塗鴉藝術家用了許多鮮豔的顏色來創作他的新作品。

examples.source: Please make sure your essay is grammatically correct before submitting it.
examples.target: 交功課之前，請確保你的文章文法正確。

examples.source: He tried his best to write a grammatically correct email to his teacher.
examples.target: 他盡力寫了一封文法正確的電郵給老師。

examples.source: If you want to get high marks, your sentences must be grammatically correct.
examples.target: 如果你想取得高分，你的句子必須文法正確。

examples.source: She wants to study graphic design at university next year.
examples.target: 她明年想在大學修讀平面設計。

examples.source: He uses a computer to create his graphic design projects.
examples.target: 他利用電腦來製作他的平面設計專題。

examples.source: Graphic design is important when you make a new poster.
examples.target: 當你製作新海報時，平面設計非常重要。

examples.source: My sister works as a graphic designer for a magazine.
examples.target: 我姐姐在一家雜誌社擔任平面設計師。

examples.source: The graphic designer created a beautiful poster for our school.
examples.target: 那位平面設計師為我們學校製作了一張漂亮的海報。

examples.source: If you like drawing, you should become a graphic designer.
examples.target: 如果你喜歡畫畫，你應該成為一名平面設計師。

graphic novel.meaning: 圖像小說 / 漫畫小說

examples.source: I borrowed a graphic novel from the school library yesterday.
examples.target: 我昨天從學校圖書館借了一本圖像小說。

examples.source: She likes reading a graphic novel when she feels bored.
examples.target: 她感到無聊時喜歡看圖像小說。

examples.source: This graphic novel has beautiful pictures and an exciting story.
examples.target: 這本圖像小說有精美的圖畫和精彩的故事。

examples.source: I got a grass stain on my trousers during football practice.
examples.target: 我踢足球練習時，褲子上留下了草漬。

examples.source: My jeans have a grass stain because I sat on the lawn.
examples.target: 因為我坐在草地上，所以我的牛仔褲上有草漬。

examples.source: It is hard to remove a grass stain from white socks.
examples.target: 要洗掉白襪子上的草漬是很困難的。

examples.source: I saw a green grasshopper jumping in the school garden.
examples.target: 我看見一隻綠色蚱蜢在學校花園裡跳。

examples.source: The grasshopper hid in the tall grass when I walked by.
examples.target: 當我走過時，那隻蚱蜢藏在高草裡。

examples.source: If you look closely, you can find a grasshopper on the leaf.
examples.target: 如果你仔細觀察，就會發現葉上有一隻蚱蜢。

examples.source: The cows are eating grass on the large green grassland.
examples.target: 牛群正在大片綠色的草原上吃草。

examples.source: We went for a picnic on the grassland last Sunday.
examples.target: 上星期日我們去草原上野餐。

examples.source: The grassland looks beautiful when the sun shines on it.
examples.target: 當陽光照在草原上時，景色非常美麗。

examples.source: We sat on the grassy hill to enjoy the warm sunshine.
examples.target: 我們坐在長滿草的小山上享受溫暖的陽光。

examples.source: The dog likes running across the grassy field every afternoon.
examples.target: 那隻狗每天下午都喜歡在長滿草的草地上奔跑。

examples.source: It is nice to walk along the grassy path in spring.
examples.target: 春天在長滿草的小徑上散步感覺真好。

examples.source: I write in my gratitude journal every night before I sleep.
examples.target: 我每晚睡前都會寫感恩日記。

examples.source: Keeping a gratitude journal helps me feel happier every day.
examples.target: 寫感恩日記令我每天都感到更快樂。

examples.source: She started a gratitude journal because she wanted to be positive.
examples.target: 她開始寫感恩日記，因為她想變得更積極。

examples.source: The cows graze in a meadow near the quiet village.
examples.target: 牛群在寧靜村莊附近的草地吃草。

examples.source: We saw some sheep graze in a meadow this morning.
examples.target: 我們今早看見幾隻羊在草地吃草。

examples.source: If you go to the farm, you can watch horses graze in a meadow.
examples.target: 如果你去農場，你可以看見馬兒在草地吃草。

examples.source: He spent a great deal of time studying for the exam.
examples.target: 他花了很多時間準備考試。

examples.source: There is a great deal of traffic on the road today.
examples.target: 今天路上的交通非常繁忙。

examples.source: We have a great deal of work to finish by tomorrow.
examples.target: 我們明天前有很多工作要完成。

examples.source: We love spending time in the great outdoors during the weekend.
examples.target: 我們週末很喜歡在大自然中度過時光。

examples.source: The great outdoors is a perfect place to exercise and relax.
examples.target: 戶外天地是運動和放鬆的絕佳地方。

examples.source: If you enjoy the great outdoors, you should go hiking today.
examples.target: 如果你喜歡大自然，今天就應該去遠足。

examples.source: We booked the hotel early to get a great rate.
examples.target: 我們提早預訂酒店，以獲得優惠價格。

examples.source: This website offers a great rate for flight tickets.
examples.target: 這個網站提供機票的好價錢。

examples.source: If you buy in bulk, you can get a great rate.
examples.target: 如果你大量購買，就可以得到優惠價格。

great value for money.meaning: 很高性價比 / 很划算

examples.source: This lunch set is great value for money because it includes drinks.
examples.target: 這個午餐套餐很划算，因為包括飲品。

examples.source: The new smartphone is great value for money for most students.
examples.target: 對於大部分學生來說，這部新款智能手機性價比很高。

examples.source: If you buy it on sale, it is great value for money.
examples.target: 如果你在減價時購買，就真的很划算。

examples.source: My great-grandfather is ninety years old this year.
examples.target: 我曾祖父今年九十歲了。

examples.source: I often visit my great-grandfather on Sunday afternoons.
examples.target: 我經常在星期日下午探望曾祖父。

examples.source: My great-grandfather told us stories when we were young.
examples.target: 我們小時候，曾祖父經常講故事給我們聽。

examples.source: Many people travel to the Greater Bay Area for the weekend.
examples.target: 很多人會在週末前往大灣區旅遊。

examples.source: We can find many new job opportunities in the Greater Bay Area.
examples.target: 我們可以在大灣區找到許多新的工作機會。

examples.source: The Greater Bay Area connects Hong Kong with other nearby cities.
examples.target: 大灣區將香港與其他鄰近城市連接起來。

examples.source: Students who stay up late are at a greater risk of feeling tired.
examples.target: 熬夜的學生有較高風險感到疲倦。

examples.source: You are at a greater risk of catching a cold if you go out without a coat.
examples.target: 如果你不穿外套就出門，會有較高風險患上感冒。

examples.source: Cycling without a helmet puts you at a greater risk of injury.
examples.target: 騎單車不戴頭盔會讓你處於較高風險受傷。

examples.source: The band will play their greatest hits at the concert tonight.
examples.target: 樂隊今晚會在演唱會演奏他們的精選熱門歌曲。

examples.source: I bought a CD that features all the greatest hits of the singer.
examples.target: 我買了一張收錄了那位歌手所有精選熱門歌曲的唱片。

examples.source: Listening to their greatest hits always makes me feel very happy.
examples.target: 聽他們的精選熱門歌曲總會讓我感到非常開心。

examples.source: Cycling is a popular green mode of transport in Hong Kong.
examples.target: 踏單車是香港一種受歡迎的環保交通方式。

examples.source: We should choose a green mode of transport to protect nature.
examples.target: 我們應該選擇環保交通方式來保護大自然。

examples.source: Taking the MTR is a green mode of transport for students.
examples.target: 乘搭港鐵對學生來說是一種環保交通方式。

examples.source: We should choose greener products to help protect our planet.
examples.target: 我們應該選擇較環保的產品，以幫助保護我們的地球。

examples.source: Living in a greener city makes everyone feel much happier.
examples.target: 生活在一個較綠化的城市，會讓每個人都感到更快樂。

examples.source: If we use less plastic, our daily life will become greener.
examples.target: 如果我們少用塑膠，我們的日常生活會變得更環保。

examples.source: Cars produce greenhouse gas, which makes the planet warmer.
examples.target: 汽車會排放溫室氣體，這令地球變得更暖。

examples.source: We should reduce greenhouse gas to protect our environment.
examples.target: 我們應該減少溫室氣體，以保護我們的環境。

examples.source: Burning coal releases greenhouse gas into the air every day.
examples.target: 燃燒煤炭每天都會向空氣中釋放溫室氣體。

examples.source: Greenland is the largest island in the whole world.
examples.target: 格陵蘭是全世界最大的島嶼。

examples.source: It is very cold in Greenland during the winter months.
examples.target: 在冬季期間，格陵蘭的天氣非常寒冷。

examples.source: Many people want to visit Greenland to see the ice.
examples.target: 許多人都想去格陵蘭旅遊，看看那裡的冰川。

examples.source: Greenpeace works hard to protect our oceans and forests.
examples.target: 綠色和平致力於保護我們的海洋和森林。

examples.source: My sister joined Greenpeace because she cares about the environment.
examples.target: 我姐姐加入了綠色和平，因為她很關心環境。

examples.source: If you want to help nature, you can support Greenpeace.
examples.target: 如果你想幫助大自然，你可以支持綠色和平。

examples.source: The boy started to groan when he saw his heavy homework.
examples.target: 那個男孩看到沉重的功課時，開始抱怨地嘆氣。

examples.source: She let out a soft groan because her back was sore.

grocery store.meaning: 雜貨店 / 食品雜貨店

examples.target: 我去了雜貨店買一些新鮮水果。

examples.target: 我媽媽每個星期日早上都會去雜貨店。

examples.source: We can get milk at the grocery store if we run out.
examples.target: 如果我們喝完了牛奶，可以去雜貨店買。

examples.target: 我們每個月都會帶狗狗去寵物美容服務。

examples.target: 練習後，她想明白了新系統。

examples.source: It is hard to get your mind around such a large number.
examples.target: 要理解這麼大的數字並不容易。

get one's start.meaning: 開始起步 / 初露頭角

examples.source: She got her start in a small theatre.
examples.target: 她在一間小劇院開始起步。

examples.source: Many writers get their start by writing short stories.
examples.target: 很多作家由寫短篇故事開始起步。

examples.source: He got his start as a student reporter.
examples.target: 他以學生記者身份初露頭角。

get one's teeth into.meaning: 專心投入 / 認真處理

examples.source: She wanted a project she could get her teeth into.
examples.target: 她想要一個可以專心投入的項目。

examples.source: The class got its teeth into the debate topic.
examples.target: 全班認真處理辯論題目。

examples.source: He got his teeth into the research after lunch.
examples.target: 午飯後，他專心投入研究。

get out of one's head.meaning: 停止困在自己的思緒中 / 暫時不再胡思亂想

examples.source: A walk helped him get out of his head.
examples.target: 散步幫助他暫時不再胡思亂想。

examples.source: Writing notes can help you get out of your head.
examples.target: 寫筆記可以幫助你停止困在自己的思緒中。

examples.source: She listened to music to get out of her head.
examples.target: 她聽音樂，讓自己暫時不再胡思亂想。

examples.source: Let us get the homework out of the way first.
examples.target: 讓我們先把功課處理掉。

examples.source: She got the hard task out of the way before lunch.
examples.target: 她午飯前先完成困難任務。

examples.source: We should get the forms out of the way today.
examples.target: 我們今天應該先把表格處理掉。

get out to the public.meaning: 傳到公眾耳中 / 被公眾知道

examples.source: The news got out to the public quickly.
examples.target: 消息很快傳到公眾耳中。

examples.source: The report must be checked before it gets out to the public.
examples.target: 報告被公眾知道前必須先檢查。

examples.source: Once the video got out to the public, people reacted strongly.
examples.target: 影片一傳到公眾耳中，人們反應強烈。

get over oneself.meaning: 別太在意自己 / 放下成見

examples.source: He needed to get over himself and accept advice.
examples.target: 他需要別太在意自己，接受建議。

examples.source: The coach told the players to get over themselves.
examples.target: 教練叫球員放下成見。

examples.source: Sometimes we must get over ourselves to improve.
examples.target: 有時我們要放下自我，才可以進步。

examples.source: When you get right down to it, practice matters most.
examples.target: 說到底，練習最重要。

examples.source: When we get right down to it, the plan is simple.
examples.target: 說穿了，計劃很簡單。

examples.source: Get right down to it and tell me the main problem.
examples.target: 說到底，告訴我主要問題。

examples.source: Do not get smart with your teacher.
examples.target: 不要對老師頂嘴。

examples.source: He got smart with the coach and lost practice time.
examples.target: 他對教練頂嘴，失去了練習時間。

examples.source: She was warned not to get smart with adults.
examples.target: 她被提醒不要對成年人自作聰明。

examples.source: I want to get your take on this article.
examples.target: 我想聽取你對這篇文章的看法。

examples.source: The reporter got the teacher's take on the new rule.
examples.target: 記者聽取老師對新規則的看法。

examples.source: Let us get her take on the problem first.
examples.target: 讓我們先聽取她對問題的看法。

get something out to.meaning: 把某物傳給 / 發放給

examples.source: The school got the notice out to parents.
examples.target: 學校把通知發放給家長。

examples.source: We need to get the survey out to students today.
examples.target: 我們今天要把問卷發給學生。

examples.source: The team got the message out to all members.
examples.target: 團隊把訊息傳給所有成員。

examples.source: Many students got swept up in the excitement.
examples.target: 很多學生被興奮氣氛吸引住。

examples.source: He got swept up in the argument by accident.
examples.target: 他意外捲入爭論。

examples.source: She got swept up in the story and forgot the time.
examples.target: 她被故事吸引住，忘記了時間。

examples.source: Every worker should get the respect they deserve.
examples.target: 每位工人都應得到應有的尊重。

examples.source: The artist finally got the respect she deserved.
examples.target: 藝術家終於得到她應有的尊重。

examples.source: Students want their efforts to get the respect they deserve.
examples.target: 學生希望自己的努力得到應有的尊重。

get to the bottom of.meaning: 弄清真相 / 找出原因

examples.source: The teacher wanted to get to the bottom of the mistake.
examples.target: 老師想弄清錯誤的真相。

examples.source: We must get to the bottom of the delay.
examples.target: 我們必須找出延誤的原因。

examples.source: The reporter tried to get to the bottom of the story.
examples.target: 記者嘗試弄清事件真相。

give insight into.meaning: 讓人了解 / 提供深入了解

examples.source: The diary gives insight into her daily life.
examples.target: 日記讓人了解她的日常生活。

examples.source: The survey gives insight into students' habits.
examples.target: 調查提供對學生習慣的深入了解。

examples.source: This interview gives insight into the writer's mind.
examples.target: 這次訪問讓人了解作者的想法。

give new life to.meaning: 賦予...新生命 / 令...重現活力

examples.source: The renovation gave new life to the old market.
examples.target: 翻新工程令舊市場重現活力。

examples.source: The new ending gave new life to the story.
examples.target: 新結局賦予故事新生命。

examples.source: Art can give new life to empty spaces.
examples.target: 藝術可以令空置空間重現活力。

examples.source: She gave off an air of confidence during the interview.
examples.target: 她在面試中散發自信感。

examples.source: The speaker gave off an air of confidence on stage.
examples.target: 講者在台上散發自信感。

examples.source: His calm voice gave off an air of confidence.
examples.target: 他平靜的聲音散發自信感。

give one's wallet a break.meaning: 讓錢包休息一下 / 省點錢

examples.source: Let us cook at home and give our wallets a break.
examples.target: 讓我們在家煮飯，省點錢。

examples.source: Buying second-hand books can give your wallet a break.
examples.target: 買二手書可以讓你的錢包休息一下。

examples.source: The free event gave students' wallets a break.
examples.target: 免費活動讓學生省了點錢。

give someone a leg-up.meaning: 幫某人一把 / 給某人優勢

examples.source: Extra reading can give students a leg-up.
examples.target: 額外閱讀可以給學生優勢。

examples.source: Her mentor gave her a leg-up in the industry.
examples.target: 她的導師在行業中幫了她一把。

examples.source: A good dictionary gives learners a leg-up.
examples.target: 一本好字典能幫學習者一把。

give someone pause.meaning: 令某人停下來思考 / 警惕

examples.source: The high cost gave the parents pause.
examples.target: 高昂費用令家長停下來思考。

examples.source: The warning should give students pause.
examples.target: 這個警告應令學生警惕。

examples.source: Her question gave me pause.
examples.target: 她的問題令我停下來思考。

give someone the benefit of the doubt.meaning: 姑且相信某人 / 在有疑點時仍給予信任

examples.source: The teacher gave him the benefit of the doubt.
examples.target: 老師姑且相信他。

examples.source: We should give her the benefit of the doubt until we know more.
examples.target: 在知道更多之前，我們應在有疑點時仍信任她。

examples.source: His friend gave him the benefit of the doubt.
examples.target: 他的朋友姑且相信他。

give something a good shake.meaning: 大力改變 / 徹底撼動

examples.source: The new leader gave the old system a good shake.
examples.target: 新領袖大力改變舊制度。

examples.source: The invention gave the market a good shake.
examples.target: 這項發明徹底撼動市場。

examples.source: The school gave its timetable a good shake.
examples.target: 學校大力改變時間表。

examples.source: The judges gave the nod to the youngest singer.
examples.target: 評判選中了最年輕的歌手。

examples.source: The school gave the nod to the new project.
examples.target: 學校批准了新項目。

examples.source: The editor gave the nod to her article.
examples.target: 編輯批准了她的文章。

examples.source: The textbook mentions the Global War on Terror.
examples.target: 課本提到全球反恐戰爭。

examples.source: Students studied the Global War on Terror in history class.
examples.target: 學生在歷史課研究全球反恐戰爭。

examples.source: The report discusses the effects of the Global War on Terror.
examples.target: 報告討論全球反恐戰爭的影響。

examples.source: The speech glossed over the main problem.
examples.target: 演說對主要問題輕描淡寫。

examples.source: Do not gloss over mistakes in your essay.
examples.target: 不要在文章中掩飾錯誤。

examples.source: The report glossed over the cost of the plan.
examples.target: 報告輕描淡寫地帶過計劃成本。

go back to the drawing board.meaning: 重新構思 / 重新開始計劃

examples.source: The plan failed, so we went back to the drawing board.
examples.target: 計劃失敗了，所以我們重新構思。

examples.source: After the test results, the team had to go back to the drawing board.
examples.target: 測試結果出來後，團隊要重新開始計劃。

examples.source: The teacher told us to go back to the drawing board.
examples.target: 老師叫我們重新構思。

go down a rabbit hole.meaning: 越查越深入 / 陷入某個興趣坑

examples.source: I went down a rabbit hole while researching old maps.
examples.target: 我研究舊地圖時越查越深入。

examples.source: She went down a rabbit hole of music videos.
examples.target: 她陷入音樂影片的興趣坑。

examples.source: Do not go down a rabbit hole before finishing homework.
examples.target: 做完功課前不要越查越深入。

examples.source: The team went down in flames in the final match.
examples.target: 隊伍在決賽中慘敗。

examples.source: His risky plan went down in flames.
examples.target: 他的冒險計劃慘敗收場。

examples.source: In the film, the plane went down in flames.
examples.target: 電影中，飛機起火墜落。

go down that road.meaning: 走上那條路 / 採取那個做法

examples.source: If we go down that road, the project will become too costly.
examples.target: 如果我們採取那個做法，項目會變得太昂貴。

examples.source: The school decided not to go down that road.
examples.target: 學校決定不走上那條路。

examples.source: Think carefully before you go down that road.
examples.target: 採取那個做法前要仔細考慮。

examples.source: The new rule did not go down well with students.
examples.target: 新規則不太被學生接受。

examples.source: Her joke went down badly with the audience.
examples.target: 她的笑話受到觀眾差劣反應。

examples.source: The idea went down well with parents.
examples.target: 這個想法受到家長良好反應。

go on a bit.meaning: 說個不停 / 講得太長

examples.source: The speaker went on a bit during the introduction.
examples.target: 講者在引言部分講得太長。

examples.source: I know I went on a bit about the book.
examples.target: 我知道我說那本書說個不停。

examples.source: The teacher went on a bit, but the advice was useful.
examples.target: 老師講得有點長，但建議很有用。

examples.source: The new activity went over well with the class.
examples.target: 新活動在班中反應良好。

examples.source: His suggestion did not go over well.
examples.target: 他的建議沒有被接受。

examples.source: The speech went over well with parents.
examples.target: 演說受到家長良好反應。

go so far as to.meaning: 甚至做到 / 竟然做到

examples.source: He went so far as to rewrite the whole report.
examples.target: 他甚至重寫了整份報告。

examples.source: She went so far as to call every parent.
examples.target: 她竟然致電每位家長。

examples.source: The club went so far as to cancel the event.
examples.target: 學會甚至取消了活動。

go so far as to say.meaning: 甚至可以說 / 說到...的程度

examples.source: I would go so far as to say this is her best essay.
examples.target: 我甚至可以說這是她最好的文章。

examples.source: The critic went so far as to say the film was perfect.
examples.target: 評論家甚至說這部電影完美。

examples.source: Some teachers go so far as to say practice is everything.
examples.target: 有些老師甚至可以說練習就是一切。

go through the motions.meaning: 敷衍了事 / 只是做樣子

examples.source: He did the exercise but only went through the motions.
examples.target: 他做了練習，但只是敷衍了事。

examples.source: The team seemed to be going through the motions.
examples.target: 隊伍看似只是做樣子。

examples.source: Do not just go through the motions when you revise.
examples.target: 溫習時不要只是敷衍了事。

go to elaborate lengths.meaning: 不惜費盡心思 / 大費周章

examples.source: The museum went to elaborate lengths to protect the paintings.
examples.target: 博物館不惜費盡心思保護畫作。

examples.source: She went to elaborate lengths to prepare the surprise.
examples.target: 她大費周章準備驚喜。

examples.source: The school went to elaborate lengths to welcome visitors.
examples.target: 學校不惜費盡心思歡迎訪客。

go to great lengths.meaning: 不遺餘力 / 盡很大努力

examples.source: Parents go to great lengths to help their children.
examples.target: 家長不遺餘力幫助子女。

examples.source: The team went to great lengths to check the data.
examples.target: 團隊盡很大努力檢查數據。

examples.source: Good writers go to great lengths to choose the right words.
examples.target: 好作者不遺餘力選擇合適字詞。

go up for auction.meaning: 拿去拍賣 / 上拍賣場

examples.source: The old watch will go up for auction next month.
examples.target: 這隻舊手錶下月會拿去拍賣。

examples.source: Several paintings went up for auction in London.
examples.target: 幾幅畫在倫敦上拍賣場。

examples.source: The rare book is expected to go up for auction soon.
examples.target: 這本珍本書預計很快會拿去拍賣。

go-to resource.meaning: 首選求助對象 / 常用資源

examples.source: This dictionary is my go-to resource for vocabulary.
examples.target: 這本字典是我查生字的常用資源。

examples.source: The teacher became a go-to resource for grammar questions.
examples.target: 老師成為文法問題的首選求助對象。

examples.source: The website is a go-to resource for exam practice.
examples.target: 這個網站是考試練習的常用資源。

examples.source: The newsletter reports the goings-on at school.
examples.target: 通訊報道學校發生的事。

examples.source: She asked about the goings-on in the club.
examples.target: 她詢問學會近況。

examples.source: The villagers discussed the strange goings-on.
examples.target: 村民討論那些奇怪的事情。

grapple with.meaning: 努力應付 / 設法解決

examples.source: Students grappled with the difficult question.
examples.target: 學生努力應付困難問題。

examples.source: The city must grapple with rising waste.
examples.target: 城市必須設法解決日益增加的垃圾。

examples.source: She grappled with the decision for days.
examples.target: 她花了幾天努力處理這個決定。

examples.source: He changed schools because he thought the grass was greener on the other side.
examples.target: 他轉校，因為總覺得別人的較好。

examples.source: The saying warns us that the grass is greener on the other side.
examples.target: 這句諺語提醒我們，人總覺得別人的較好。

examples.source: Do not quit just because the grass seems greener on the other side.
examples.target: 不要只因覺得別人的較好就放棄。

green in judgement.meaning: 判斷幼嫩的 / 缺乏經驗的

examples.source: The young leader was still green in judgement.
examples.target: 年輕領袖在判斷上仍然幼嫩。

examples.source: He made a green-in-judgement decision.
examples.target: 他作出一個缺乏經驗的決定。

examples.source: The story shows a hero who is green in judgement.
examples.target: 故事描寫一位判斷幼嫩的主角。

groove to.meaning: 隨...節奏擺動 / 享受...音樂

examples.source: The crowd grooved to the music.
examples.target: 人群隨音樂節奏擺動。

examples.source: She grooved to the old song while cooking.
examples.target: 她煮飯時享受那首舊歌。

examples.source: Students grooved to the beat at the school fair.
examples.target: 學生在校園嘉年華隨節奏擺動。

ground to a halt.meaning: 慢慢停下 / 停頓下來

examples.source: Traffic ground to a halt after the accident.
examples.target: 意外後，交通慢慢停下。

examples.source: The project ground to a halt when funding ended.
examples.target: 資金終止後，項目停頓下來。

examples.source: The conversation ground to a halt.
examples.target: 對話慢慢停了下來。

examples.source: Cheating is grounds for disqualification.
examples.target: 作弊是取消資格的理由。

examples.source: Late submission may be grounds for disqualification.
examples.target: 遲交可能是取消資格的理由。

examples.source: The rules list all grounds for disqualification.
examples.target: 規則列出所有取消資格的理由。

grow up before one's time.meaning: 過早成熟 / 太早承擔成人責任

examples.source: The character had to grow up before her time.
examples.target: 角色不得不過早成熟。

examples.source: Some children grow up before their time because of family pressure.
examples.target: 有些孩子因家庭壓力太早承擔成人責任。

examples.source: The novel shows how war made children grow up before their time.
examples.target: 小說展示戰爭如何令孩子過早成熟。

examples.source: There is no guaranteed road to success.
examples.target: 沒有必然成功之路。

examples.source: The article warns against believing in a guaranteed road to success.
examples.target: 文章提醒人們不要相信必然成功之路。

examples.source: Practice helps, but it is not a guaranteed road to success.
examples.target: 練習有幫助，但不是必然成功之路。
